sermon.title: The Real Deal - February 18, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: We want an authentic God and to be authentic people. The message covers five areas: genuine parenting with discipline and example, no favoritism by ethnicity or skin color, God’s design of male and female and marriage, diligent work and study, and real Christianity that grows over time. The service closes with communion and prayer.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He cites “Genesis 2:8” for “not good for man to be alone” (it is 2:18) and “Daniel chapter 13” for Daniel and his friends studying; left as said, and refs point to the intended verses.

faqs.answer: His home may have been normal 30 or 50 years ago, but not now.

faqs.question: What illustrates hard work?
faqs.answer: Step on an anthill and they all come out to fix the mound.

faqs.question: What work advice does he quote?
faqs.answer: You can have everything you want if you help enough other people get what they want.

faqs.question: When did he set his career goal?
faqs.answer: At 12; he encourages young people to set goals now.

faqs.answer: The genuine worker they hear is free and want in their company.
